REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - FEBRUARY 23, 2023 - 07:00 P.M.
SIERRA ROOM – CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS
18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
COUNCILMEMBER SOLANKI WILL PARTICIPATE VIA TELECONFERENCE FROM YADAV STREET, UPLETA, GUJARAT, INDIA, AND THIS AGENDA WILL BE POSTED AT THAT LOCATION IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CALIFORNIA GOVERNMENT CODE
* COVID-19 NOTICE *
To protect public health and safety during the COVID-19 pandemic and in compliance with the current State Department of Public Health and Los Angeles County Health Officer Orders and City of Cerritos COVID-19 Safety Plan, the Sierra Room will be open to the public. As authorized by State of California Executive Orders N-25-20, N-29-20, and N-08-21, and subsequently by Assembly Bill 361 (Chapter 165, Statutes of 2021) and City Council Resolution No. 2022-10 adopted pursuant thereto, this meeting may also be conducted via teleconference, if necessary. Public observation and participation in this meeting will be facilitated through the methods described below.
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at www.cerritos.us and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in-person in the Sierra Room subject to posted COVID-19 protocols.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in-person at the meeting or by using the following alternate methods:
Written correspondence (hard copy or email): Public comments can be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.us or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting. During the meeting, your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD THURSDAY,
FEBRUARY 23, 2023, 7:00 P.M., IN THE SIERRA ROOM AT CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE
PERFORMING ARTS, 18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.
COUNCILMEMBER SOLANKI PARTICIPATED VIA TELECONFERENCE FROM YADAV
STREET, UPLETA GUJARAT, INDIA, AND THE MEETING AGENDA WAS POSTED AT THAT
LOCATION IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CALIFORNIA GOVERNMENT CODE.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Bishop David Montgomery, Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-
  Day Saints.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Rookie II Division Youth Basketball – Team Swish.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Lynda P. Johnson
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Bruce Barrows
  Mayor/Chair Chuong Vo

5.  Presentations/Appointments

5A.  Presentations

  A proclamation was made by the City Council as follows:

  Fremont University (Business Spotlight). A proclamation was also presented from
  Assemblymember Sharon Quirk-Silva by Joe Pak, Field Representative.

5B.  Review and consideration of appointments, removals, and filling of scheduled or unscheduled
  vacancies on the Cerritos Advisory Boards (2022-24 term) (COUNCIL).

  There was no action taken on this item.

5C.  Informational update on the City’s response to the COVID-19 pandemic and other City
  events, services, and programs.

  An informational update was given by Annie Hylton, City Librarian & Marketing Manager. A
  PowerPoint presentation was displayed.

  There was no action taken on this item.

  CONSENSUS (Vo): Directed the City Manager to pull Item 9F from the February 23,
  2023 meeting agenda and to provide a report to the City Council at a future meeting
  under Closed Session, with analysis and costs related to potential salary adjustments to
  address rising inflation, incorporation of car allowances into base salaries, and to review
  and potentially reverse previous reductions in medical coverage which were
  implemented to address prior year City cash flow concerns.
 City of Cerritos  Thursday, February 23, 2023, 7:00 p.m.

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Jerry Jenson inquired as to whether an impact study had been conducted prior to the
  approval of the Gold’s Gym location at 13233 South Street, and expressed concern
  regarding the parking in the subject shopping center and of the impact to the
  surrounding businesses.

  Sean Wang expressed concern regarding the sidewalk improvements project currently
  taking place near Sunshine Park and the impacts to his property and the surrounding
  homes, and inquired as to the completion date of this project.

  David Pylman inquired regarding the process for Councilmember recusals from
  participation in agenda items, expressed concern regarding police pursuits on residential
  streets, and expressed concern regarding ABC school district needs and access to
  facilities.

  Noting there were no other individuals who elected to provide public comment, the
  Mayor declared the public comments period closed.

7.  Consent Calendar

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Thursday, February 9, 2023, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting
  Minutes (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Yokoyama, to approve the Thursday,
  February 9, 2023, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands

7B.1. Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated February 23, 2023 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Yokoyama, to approve the Register
  of Demands as follows:

  City of Cerritos  February 23, 2023  $ 3,866,434.09 (COUNCIL)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

(minutes continue on the next page)

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7C.  Award of contract for flooring replacement as part of Council Chambers Rehabilitation,
  Project No. 23206* (COUNCIL).

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Yokoyama, to:

  1. Adopt findings in accordance with the California Environmental Quality Act, Public
  Resources Code Section 21000 et seq. (CEQA) that the improvements planned under
  the proposed contract award are categorically exempt pursuant to Section 15301 of
  the CEQA Guidelines, based on the findings as set forth in the associated agenda
  report; and

  2. Award a contract in the amount of $63,912.10 for the replacement of flooring
  throughout the Council Chambers as part of Capital Project No. 23206, to
  Commercial Interior Resources; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute any project-related change
  orders, in accordance with the City’s adopted Purchasing and Contracting Policy
  (8.03) (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  MOTION: It was moved by Johnson, and seconded by Yokoyama, to:

  1. Adopt findings in accordance with the California Environmental Quality Act, Public
  Resources Code Section 21000 et seq. (CEQA) that the improvements planned under
  the proposed contract award are categorically exempt pursuant to Section 15301 of
  the CEQA Guidelines, based on the findings as set forth in the associated agenda
  report; and

  2. Award a contract in the amount of $95,000 for the South Street Sewer Repairs (total
  bid), Project No. 23605, Bid No. 1489-23, to Torres Sanitation Systems Construction
  and reject the other bids; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute any project-related change
  orders, in accordance with the City’s adopted Purchasing and Contracting Policy
  (8.03) (COUNCIL).

9B.  Review and consideration of an informational report to the Cerritos City Council
  providing an overview of the City of Cerritos 2022 General Plan Annual Progress Report
  for submittal to the California Governor’s Office of Planning and Research (OPR) and
  California Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Sabrina Chan, Advance Planning Manager. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Vo, to receive and file this report
  (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None

9C.  Review and consideration of a request submitted by Eco-Rapid Transit for the City of
  Cerritos to remit advance payment of its annual membership dues for Fiscal Year 2023-
  2024 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kristin Aguila, Director of Community Development.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period. Noting there were no individuals who
  elected to provide public comment, the Mayor declared the public comments period
  closed.

  MOTION: It was moved by Barrows, and seconded by Johnson, to authorize the City
  Manager to remit the City’s 2023-2024 Fiscal Year membership dues totaling
  $18,599.85 to Eco-Rapid Transit, subject to the City manager conducting an evaluation
  of the City’s membership status and to present said finding to the City Council for
  consideration on or before June 30, 2023, and prior to remitting any additional
  payments to Eco-Rapid Transit (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Johnson, Solanki, Yokoyama, Barrows, Vo

  ABSENT:  None

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Deputy Director of Public Works/City Engineer.
